claims.claim_zh: 9/16 美联储三年来首次加息至 3.75–4.00%
10Y 9 月底收 5.34%、2002 年以来最高，现仍在 5.2% 以上

claims.evidence: MyAlpha 收盘口径（10-09）：AAPL −1.3%，MSFT −1.3%，META −7.6%（Meta 与作者 5% 不符，可能为盘中口径）

claims.evidence: Morgan Stanley（经 Forbes 10-11）：54%

window.basis: author '接下来的三周' + owner window 10/13–11/04

instruments.primary: IWM (breadth-heavy proxy for the author's Russell 3000 argument)

preregistered_test.bottom_definition: trough = lowest daily close of the instrument within the window (date d*).

settlement.rule: 40 NYSE sessions after the last window session
settlement.date_estimate: 2027-01-04 (standard NYSE holidays; the scorer must recompute from the calendar)

outcomes.consistent: no daily close below the window trough during the settlement period AND the trough is ≥3% below the highest close of the 20 sessions before d*
outcomes.falsified: any daily close below the window trough during the settlement period
outcomes.not_testable: trough < 3% below the prior 20-session high (no meaningful decline to call a bottom) — recorded as 'no_decline_in_window', never as a success
outcomes.unavailable: missing bars for the window or settlement period → explicit unavailable, no fill

preregistered_test.never: A date alone never confirms a bottom; a close-only trough is not called a bottom until price, breadth and volatility/credit confirm (see monitoring).
